Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-bdp-1 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct An aliquot must reference its parent product (ee Pakendil peab olema viide vanemmaterjalile) division.exists() implies parent.exists()
vris-bdp-2 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Cryopreserved material must have storage temperature requirements (ee Külmutatud materjalil peab olema hoiustamistemperatuur) property.where(type.coding.code='preservation-state').value.ofType(CodeableConcept).coding.code='cryopreserved' implies storageTempRequirements.exists()
vris-bdp-3 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Fresh material must have an expiration date (ee Värskel materjalil peab olema kehtivusaeg) property.where(type.coding.code='preservation-state').value.ofType(CodeableConcept).coding.code='fresh' implies expirationDate.exists()
vris-bdp-4 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Source material must record collection details (ee Lähtematerjalil peavad olema kogumisandmed) division.empty() implies collection.exists()

vris-bdp-4 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Source material must record collection details (ee Lähtematerjalil peavad olema kogumisandmed) division.empty() implies collection.exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-bdp-1 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct An aliquot must reference its parent product (ee Pakendil peab olema viide vanemmaterjalile) division.exists() implies parent.exists()
vris-bdp-2 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Cryopreserved material must have storage temperature requirements (ee Külmutatud materjalil peab olema hoiustamistemperatuur) property.where(type.coding.code='preservation-state').value.ofType(CodeableConcept).coding.code='cryopreserved' implies storageTempRequirements.exists()
vris-bdp-3 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Fresh material must have an expiration date (ee Värskel materjalil peab olema kehtivusaeg) property.where(type.coding.code='preservation-state').value.ofType(CodeableConcept).coding.code='fresh' implies expirationDate.exists()
vris-bdp-4 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Source material must record collection details (ee Lähtematerjalil peavad olema kogumisandmed) division.empty() implies collection.exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-bdp-1 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct An aliquot must reference its parent product (ee Pakendil peab olema viide vanemmaterjalile) division.exists() implies parent.exists()
vris-bdp-2 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Cryopreserved material must have storage temperature requirements (ee Külmutatud materjalil peab olema hoiustamistemperatuur) property.where(type.coding.code='preservation-state').value.ofType(CodeableConcept).coding.code='cryopreserved' implies storageTempRequirements.exists()
vris-bdp-3 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Fresh material must have an expiration date (ee Värskel materjalil peab olema kehtivusaeg) property.where(type.coding.code='preservation-state').value.ofType(CodeableConcept).coding.code='fresh' implies expirationDate.exists()
vris-bdp-4 error BiologicallyDerivedProduct Source material must record collection details (ee Lähtematerjalil peavad olema kogumisandmed) division.empty() implies collection.exists()
